name: Goodtime
tagline: A focus timer for one task at a time
description:
Goodtime helps you sit down and concentrate. Use the classic pomodoro pattern of focus sessions with short breaks and a longer one every few rounds, or the count-up flow timer, which lets you keep going while you are in the zone and builds up break time as you do.

It is deliberately plain: no ads, no tracking, a quiet screen while the timer runs, optional Do Not Disturb during a session, and statistics afterwards so you can see how much focused time you really put in. Coloured labels keep study time and work time apart.

The Play Store version sells a Pro upgrade, but this build has everything unlocked and simply asks for a donation. One practical note: some phones kill background apps to save battery, so turn off battery optimisation for Goodtime if your alarms arrive late.
